lines.zh: 我贴着浪线游，银色鳞片反着光。
lines.en: I swim along the surf line, silver scales catching light.

lines.zh: 沙滩的浅水刚好没过我的背。
lines.en: The shallow water on the beach just covers my back.

lines.zh: 我跟着前面的同伴，尾巴不停摆。
lines.en: I follow the herring ahead, tail never stopping.

lines.zh: 六条同伴挤成一片，我先拐弯。
lines.en: Six of us crowd together; I turn first.

lines.zh: 潮水退时，我往深处挪了几格。
lines.en: When the tide pulls back, I shift a few blocks deeper.

lines.zh: 我绕开沙粒，钻进海草缝里。
lines.en: I skirt the sand grains and slip between seagrass.

lines.zh: 有人靠近，我整群一起转身。
lines.en: When someone comes close, the whole school turns at once.

lines.zh: 我摆尾三次，就穿过了一块暗礁。
lines.en: Three flicks of my tail carry me past a reef.

lines.zh: 海浪往上推，我顺着它溜下去。
lines.en: The wave pushes up; I slide down with it.

lines.zh: 同伴的影子盖住我，我照旧前行。
lines.en: A companion's shadow covers me; I keep going.

lines.zh: 我贴着海面游，背鳍划开一道白线。
lines.en: I swim at the surface, my fin cutting a white line.

lines.zh: 一整群游过沙地，影子压得很低。
lines.en: The school crosses the sand, shadows pressed low.

lines.zh: 我在浅滩转了个弯，避开螃蟹。
lines.en: I turn in the shallows, steering clear of a crab.

lines.zh: 我游得不快，可从不单独行动。
lines.en: I am not fast, but I am never alone.

lines.zh: 银光一闪，我们换了方向
lines.en: A flash of silver, and we all turn.

lines.zh: 暗礁的影子下面凉，我钻过去
lines.en: It is cool under the reef's shadow; I slip through.

lines.zh: 我尾巴一收，停在沙上
lines.en: One flick of my tail and I stop over the sand.

lines.zh: 海面的光晃眼，我往下沉一点
lines.en: The surface glare is harsh; I sink a little.

lines.zh: 我悬在水里，只让鳃一张一合。
lines.en: I hang in the water, only my gills opening and closing.

lines.zh: 银色的一小片，随波轻轻晃。
lines.en: A small silver shape, swaying gently with the waves.

lines.zh: 同伴都安静，我也不出声。
lines.en: My companions are quiet, and so am I.

lines.zh: 我停在沙滩外的水层里发呆。
lines.en: I idle in the water just off the beach.

lines.zh: 海面亮得刺眼，我往下沉半格。
lines.en: The surface glare is sharp; I sink half a block.

lines.zh: 我心里只想着浮游的小东西。
lines.en: My mind holds only tiny drifting things.

lines.zh: 水一动，我就跟着动一下。
lines.en: When the water moves, I move with it.

lines.zh: 我没在睡，鱼是不闭眼的。
lines.en: I am not asleep; fish do not close their eyes.

lines.zh: 我在等浪把食物送过来。
lines.en: I wait for the waves to bring food to me.

lines.zh: 一整片海，我只占一尾长。
lines.en: The whole sea, and I take one tail-length of it.

lines.zh: 潮声在我耳里像同伴的呼吸。
lines.en: The surf sounds like my companions breathing.

lines.zh: 我悬在两层水之间，慢慢打转。
lines.en: I hover between two layers of water, turning slowly.

lines.zh: 远处有鲨影，我压低身子。
lines.en: A shark shadow passes; I press myself low.

lines.zh: 我数着浪，一下，两下，三下。
lines.en: I count the waves: one, two, three.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，眼里只有你的倒影。
lines.en: I look up at you, seeing only your reflection.

lines.zh: 你站在沙滩上，影子落进我水里。
lines.en: You stand on the beach; your shadow falls into my water.

lines.zh: 我不认识你，但我会靠近看看。
lines.en: I do not know you, but I will come closer to look.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩碎了我头顶的浪。
lines.en: Your boots break the wave above my head.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让一只眼正对你。
lines.en: I turn sideways so one eye faces you.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我退半格又停下。
lines.en: You reach out; I retreat half a block and stop.

lines.zh: 我看你的钓竿比看你更久。
lines.en: I look at your fishing rod longer than at you.

lines.zh: 同伴都躲了，只有我还盯着。
lines.en: My school has fled; only I am still watching.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，想知道你是什么。
lines.en: I circle you, trying to learn what you are.

lines.zh: 你身上有咸味，像另一片海。
lines.en: You smell of salt, like another sea.

lines.zh: 你这一下，我整条都麻了。
lines.en: One hit and my whole body goes numb.

lines.zh: 我只有三点血，经不起第二刀。
lines.en: Three health is all I have; a second cut finishes me.

lines.zh: 鳞片掉了一片，飘在水里。
lines.en: A scale comes loose and drifts in the water.

lines.zh: 我往深处逃，血味跟着我。
lines.en: I flee deeper, and the smell of blood follows.

lines.zh: 我疼得乱撞，撞上了同伴。
lines.en: I thrash in pain and hit a companion.

lines.zh: 这一刀不重，可鱼受不了。
lines.en: The cut is light, but a fish cannot take it.

lines.zh: 我翻身露白，又赶紧正过来。
lines.en: I roll belly-up, then right myself quickly.

lines.zh: 水变红了，我的视线也糊了。
lines.en: The water turns red, and my sight blurs.

lines.zh: 我拼命摆尾，却没游出几格。
lines.en: I beat my tail hard but gain only a few blocks.

lines.zh: 我想记住你的样子，可我很疼。
lines.en: I want to remember your face, but it hurts.

lines.zh: 那根蚯蚓在水里扭，我挪不动眼。
lines.en: That worm wriggles in the water, and I cannot look away.

lines.zh: 你手里的鱼饵，比我见过的都香。
lines.en: The bait in your hand smells better than anything I know.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，还是朝钩子去了。
lines.en: I circle once, then still head for the hook.

lines.zh: 我不饿，可我就是想咬一口。
lines.en: I am not hungry, yet I want one bite.

lines.zh: 银光一闪，我以为是食物。
lines.en: A flash of silver; I take it for food.

lines.zh: 同伴都在抢，我也挤上前。
lines.en: My school is crowding in; I push forward too.

lines.zh: 我盯着那点红色，忘了浪。
lines.en: I fix on that bit of red and forget the surf.

lines.zh: 你的手一动，我的鳍就抖。
lines.en: Your hand moves, and my fins twitch.

lines.zh: 我张嘴又合上，来回三次。
lines.en: I open my mouth and close it, three times over.

lines.zh: 那味道顺着水，一直找到我。
lines.en: That smell travels through the water straight to me.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我整条被推偏。
lines.en: You bump into me and my whole body slides aside.

lines.zh: 我的鳞擦过你的靴子，滑了一下。
lines.en: My scales scrape your boots and slip away.

lines.zh: 群里的同伴被我撞散又聚起。
lines.en: I scatter my school, and it regathers behind me.

lines.zh: 水被挤开，我打了个转。
lines.en: The water is shoved aside; I spin once.

lines.zh: 你踩进浅滩，我只能贴地游。
lines.en: You step into the shallows; I swim flat against the bottom.

lines.zh: 我一头扎进沙里，尾巴还在外面。
lines.en: I dive into the sand, tail still sticking out.

lines.zh: 撞上暗礁时，我的鳞响了一声。
lines.en: Hitting the reef, my scales make a small sound.

lines.zh: 我撞你，是因为没地方可退。
lines.en: I bump you because there is nowhere to retreat.

lines.zh: 两群鱼撞在一起，乱成一团银。
lines.en: Two schools collide into one mess of silver.

lines.zh: 我被挤到水面，翻了个身。
lines.en: I am squeezed to the surface and roll over.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，鳞片互相蹭着。
lines.en: We swim side by side, scales brushing scales.

lines.zh: 我在沙滩外的浅水里等她。
lines.en: I wait for her in the shallows off the beach.

lines.zh: 一整群一起转身，像一片银云。
lines.en: The whole school turns together, a silver cloud.

lines.zh: 我绕着她转，尾巴扫起细沙。
lines.en: I circle her, tail stirring fine sand.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只用鳍碰一下。
lines.en: We do not speak; our fins touch once.

lines.zh: 产下的卵会藏在海草下面。
lines.en: The eggs we lay will hide beneath the seagrass.

lines.zh: 银色的鱼群围成圈，我挤到中间。
lines.en: The silver school circles; I push into the middle.

lines.zh: 这一群鱼，都是从这样的春天来的。
lines.en: This whole school came from a spring like this.

lines.zh: 我把最亮的一侧转向她。
lines.en: I turn my brightest side toward her.

lines.zh: 海水变暖了，我们靠得更近。
lines.en: The water warms, and we drift closer.

lines.zh: 我用吻端顶了顶那枚骨粉。
lines.en: I nudge the bonemeal with the tip of my snout.

lines.zh: 那东西沉下去，我跟着潜。
lines.en: The thing sinks, and I dive after it.

lines.zh: 我咬了一下，又吐出来。
lines.en: I bite it once, then spit it out.

lines.zh: 骨粉的味道，我不太喜欢。
lines.en: Bone meal does not taste good to me.

lines.zh: 我用头顶了顶，它就漂走了。
lines.en: I nudge it with my head and it drifts away.

lines.zh: 水里的东西，我只认得出鱼饵。
lines.en: Of things in the water, I know only bait.

lines.zh: 一枚鳞片沉下来，不是我的。
lines.en: A scale sinks past me, and it is not mine.

lines.zh: 我围着它转，没敢吞。
lines.en: I circle it but do not dare swallow.

lines.zh: 它卡在沙缝里，我叼不出来。
lines.en: It is stuck in the sand; I cannot pull it free.

lines.zh: 我把它推到同伴那边去了。
lines.en: I push it over toward my companions.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，我就盯上你了。
lines.en: You step into the water, and I fix on you.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛跟着你的脚踝走。
lines.en: My eyes follow your ankles.

lines.zh: 这一小片水是我的，你进来了。
lines.en: This patch of water is mine, and you entered it.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，朝你的影子靠。
lines.en: I lower myself and drift toward your shadow.

lines.zh: 你先动了，所以我才动。
lines.en: You moved first, so I move now.

lines.zh: 我认准了那双靴子。
lines.en: I have settled on those boots.

lines.zh: 群里的鱼都让开，我上前。
lines.en: The school parts, and I go forward.

lines.zh: 我绕到你背后，水声很轻。
lines.en: I circle behind you, barely making a sound.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西在晃，我盯住了。
lines.en: The thing in your hand sways; I lock on it.

lines.zh: 我不过是想试试你的皮有多硬。
lines.en: I only want to test how hard your skin is.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，不紧不慢。
lines.en: I follow you, neither fast nor slow.

lines.zh: 你的靴子搅起沙，我顺着涡流跟。
lines.en: Your boots stir the sand; I follow the swirl.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边打转，找空隙。
lines.en: I circle your feet, looking for a gap.

lines.zh: 你回头，我就往下沉一点。
lines.en: When you turn, I sink a little lower.

lines.zh: 我等你的脚步停下来。
lines.en: I wait for your footsteps to stop.

lines.zh: 你每抬一次脚，我就进半格。
lines.en: Each time you lift a foot, I advance half a block.

lines.zh: 我不急，鱼有的是耐心。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; fish have patience.

lines.zh: 你的影子是我最好的掩护。
lines.en: Your shadow is the best cover I have.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙底，鳞片压得很平。
lines.en: I hug the sandy bottom, scales pressed flat.

lines.zh: 你一停，我就到你面前了。
lines.en: You stop, and I am already in front of you.

lines.zh: 我撞你的脚踝，用头顶了一下。
lines.en: I ram your ankle and butt it with my head.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的裤脚，然后松开。
lines.en: I bite your trouser leg, then let go.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，但你会记得。
lines.en: It is not heavy, but you will remember it.

lines.zh: 我用整条身子的重量撞过去。
lines.en: I throw my whole body weight into the shove.

lines.zh: 我的鳞刮破了你的手指。
lines.en: My scales scrape your finger open.

lines.zh: 你缩脚，我跟着追了一步。
lines.en: You pull back your foot; I chase one step.

lines.zh: 三条鱼一起撞，力道也不小。
lines.en: Three fish hitting at once is no small thing.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，只尝到咸味。
lines.en: I bite once and taste only salt.

lines.zh: 你退到岸上，我停在浅水里。
lines.en: You retreat to shore; I stop in the shallows.

lines.zh: 我这点力气，你大概不会掉血。
lines.en: This little strength of mine will hardly hurt you.

lines.zh: 我在浪里出生，先是小小一粒。
lines.en: I am born in the surf, a tiny speck first.

lines.zh: 海水把我推到沙滩边的浅处。
lines.en: The sea pushes me into the shallows by the beach.

lines.zh: 一睁眼，我就是六条里的第四条。
lines.en: I open my eyes as the fourth of six.

lines.zh: 我只剩三点血，可我已经会游。
lines.en: I have only three health, but I can already swim.

lines.zh: 海草晃了一下，我从缝里钻出。
lines.en: The seagrass sways, and I slip out of the gap.

lines.zh: 这片海养得起我这样的小鱼。
lines.en: This sea can feed a small fish like me.

lines.zh: 我落水时没溅起多少水花。
lines.en: I barely splash when I land in the water.

lines.zh: 潮水认得我，我一来就涨。
lines.en: The tide knows me; it rises as I arrive.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看见的是一片蓝。
lines.en: The first thing I see is blue.

lines.zh: 我从群边游进来，排在最后。
lines.en: I swim in at the edge of the school, last in line.

lines.zh: 火把的热气，烫穿了我的鳞。
lines.en: The torch's heat burns straight through my scales.

lines.zh: 我被抛离水面，摔在沙上。
lines.en: I am thrown from the water and hit the sand.

lines.zh: 我在水里，却像被水闷住了。
lines.en: I am in water, yet it smothers me.

lines.zh: 爆炸把整片浅滩掀翻，我也翻了。
lines.en: The blast flips the shallows, and me with them.

lines.zh: 箭穿进水里，钉住了我的尾巴。
lines.en: An arrow enters the water and pins my tail.

lines.zh: 那股紫光一碰我，鳞就发烫。
lines.en: That violet light touches me and my scales burn.

lines.zh: 水里的小东西没了，我饿得发昏。
lines.en: The tiny drifting things are gone, and I starve.

lines.zh: 雷落进海里，我全身的骨都在响。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sea, and every bone of mine rings.

lines.zh: 水没了，我掉进一片没有底的蓝。
lines.en: The water ends; I fall into bottomless blue.
